d: The exterior aspect of a magnificent temple dedicated to Bacchus, from where you go down two spacious stairs. It is the temple surrounded by porticoes, which, extending from both sides, form a great square. Between the distances of the columns of the arcades discovered on one side the sacred wood to the deity, on the other the marina of Sciro. The square is filled with Baccanti, who, celebrating the feasts of their number, at the sound of various instruments sing the following choir. Preceded and followed by numerous courting of noble Donzelle, descend you see from the temple and advance gradually Deidamia, and Achilles in feminine dress.
Nearco and then Ulysses and Arcade of the ships.
Apartments in Deidamia. Lycomede and Deidamia.
Delicious in the palace of Licomede. Achilles and Deidamia, then Licomede and Teagene.
Earthly loggias adorned with statues representing various undertakings of Hercules. Ulysses and Arcades.

Great room illuminated in time at night, corresponding to several apartments, equally illuminated. Table in the middle, beliefs around; loggias in the top, filled with Music and Spectators. Lycomede, Teagene, Ulisse and Deidamia, seated at the table; Arcade standing next to Ulysses; Achilles standing next to Deidamia; and for all Knights, Damigelle and Paggi.
Achilles, and Ulysses with Arcade in the background.
Porticos of the palace corresponding to the sea. Ships not far from the shore. Ulysses, and Achilles in military dress.
Licomede, Achilles, Teagene, with numerous Corteggio.
Odysseus, then Deidamia, and sayings; so say ye all.
